- **Copy speed report** (Settings): one click puts a short summary of your dictation timings on the clipboard - how long you waited after letting go, and where that time went. Paste it into your chat about SpeakOn's speed. It contains numbers only, never what you said.
- **Safer updates**: Update now first keeps a copy of the current version. If the new files can't all be written (for example a file held open by an antivirus), SpeakOn puts the old files back and opens the old version, instead of being left half-updated. Tested on Windows with a file held open on purpose.

New here? Download SpeakOn-1.2.7-windows-x64.zip, unzip, run SpeakOn.exe. Windows only.
